principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor interface forces all implementing payment processors (Paypal, CreditCard) to implement the auth_sms method, regardless of whether they need SMS authentication, violating the Interface Segregation Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the SMS authentication to a secondary interface, such as SMSEnabledProcessor, which classes can optionally implement if they support SMS authentication.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
